title: [2.8] TDD in Statistics is misscalculated
symptom: In AAPS 2.8, the Total Daily Dose (TDD) for today is shown as zero, and the Average 8 days results are corrupted. After a phone restart, statistics show completely different and obviously corrupted results, with a repeating value of 25.62 (the user's base basal insulin). Pre-migration data (before upgrading to 2.8) cannot be loaded, showing no TIR and average for days before installation.
cause: The issue appears to be related to data migration from version 2.7.0 to 2.8.0. The user migrated on January 3rd, which is the last day with correct numbers. The problem seems to resolve itself once all data has been logged under version 2.8, as the user confirmed that statistics became correct after all days were under 2.8.
fix: The problem resolved itself after waiting several days until all statistics were logged under version 2.8. The user confirmed: 'The Statistics are correctly calculated now that all of them have been logged under 2.8 version.' No specific setting change was required.
evidence_quote: The Statistics are correctly calculated now that all of them have been logged under 2.8 version.
